actions.name: Use
actions.area: enemies within a 15-ft.-radius spread centered on you

description.summary: The caster emulates a dark skeleton by siphoning blood from all nearby enemies within 15-ft
description.value: The caster emulates a dark skeleton by siphoning blood from all nearby enemies within 15-ft.-radius spread. All enemies must make a Fortitude save for half damage or take 9d6 points of shadow damage and the caster is healed by half of the total damage. A successful save halves the damage taken and the caster isn’t healed by damage done to those who succeed their saves. Learned From Ghost Family and Skeleton Family
